summary: Get list of deleted specification sections for a Project
description: This endpoint returns deleted specification sections for a Project.

parameters.name: filter_set_id
parameters.description: Filter by specification set ID. Use 'none' for sections without a set.

parameters.name: filter_division_id
parameters.description: Filter by a single specification section division ID.

parameters.name: filter_division_ids
parameters.description: Filter by multiple specification section division IDs.

parameters.name: search_string
parameters.description: Search string to filter sections by number, description, division description, set name, or revision.

parameters.name: exclude_ids
parameters.description: Array of specification section revision IDs to exclude from results.

schema.description: Specification Sections deletion log collection Response

data.description: deleted specification sections for a project

revision.description: Revision number of the deleted Section Revision

description.description: Specification Section Description as free form text

deleted_at.description: Date of deletion of the Specification Section Revision

updated_at.description: Date of last update on the Specification Section Revision

issued_date.description: Date of issue of the Specification Section Revision

received_date.description: Date of receiving of the Specification Section Revision

deleted_by.description: User who deleted the Specification Section Revision

set.description: Set to which the deleted Specification Section Revision belongs

403.description: User does not have right permissions
